transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I just can’t get past this feeling that I’ve failed… as a father, and just as a useful person. It keeps going around in my head, and after a while I start feeling like I don’t really deserve much of a future.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About a month now. It really started after my daughter left for college out of state. Since then it’s just been… kind of constant.
Have you experienced any periods where these feelings of failure and despair were extremely severe?

Yes. There are times it gets really severe—where it’s not just a passing thought. I get stuck on this idea that I’ve failed my daughter, failed at being useful, and it just keeps repeating in my head until I feel like I don’t really deserve a future.
Have you ever had thoughts of harming yourself during these severe periods?

Yes… I have. I’ve been thinking sometimes that it would be easier if I just didn’t wake up. And what really scared me was I caught myself looking over my finances like I was getting things in order for someone else.
Have you been enjoying activities or hobbies that you typically find pleasurable?

No… not really. I used to really look forward to working on my model railway, and watching Cubs games with my daughter. Now the trains are just sitting there half-built on the table, and even turning on a game feels… pointless.
Have you noticed any decrease in your interest in activities you used to enjoy over the past month?

Yes. Over the past month, I’ve really lost interest in things I used to care about. The model railway just sits there half-finished, and even watching Cubs games with my daughter feels like too much—like there’s no point in turning it on.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight over the past month?
Yeah… I think so. I haven’t really been eating much. Most days I don’t make a real meal, and I’ll forget to eat until late, then just have toast or cereal. I’ve had to tighten my belt lately.
Have you noticed yourself moving more slowly or feeling restless and unable to sit still over the past month?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed myself pacing or anything like that, and I don’t know if I’m moving slower. I mostly just feel… off, I guess, but I can’t say for sure on that.
Have you felt like you're moving slower than usual over the past month?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed myself moving slower, exactly. I feel slowed down inside sometimes, but I can’t say if other people would see me moving differently.
Have you felt restless or had an inability to sit still over the past month?
I don’t think so. I mean, I haven’t noticed that I can’t sit still or that I’m restless in that way. I’m mostly just kind of sitting around when I am sitting.
Have you experienced any strange thoughts or heard voices that others couldn't hear over the past month?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t heard voices or had thoughts that seemed strange like that.
Have you had more than one period like this in your life where you felt this level of despair and failure?

I’m not really sure how to answer that. I can’t think of another time that was clearly like this, at this same level. Maybe I’ve had hard periods before, but I don’t know that I’d say it was the same.
Have you ever felt this level of despair and failure before in your life?

I don’t think I’ve felt it quite like this before. This time it’s this constant feeling that I’ve failed as a father and as a useful person. It just keeps going around in my head, and I end up feeling like I don’t deserve much of a future.
Have you had any other periods in your life similar to this one where you felt overwhelmed by feelings of failure and despair?

Not really, not like this. I’ve felt bad about myself before, but this is different. I came in because I just can’t shake this feeling that I’ve failed as a father and as a useful person. It keeps looping in my head, and then I start feeling like I don’t deserve much of a future.
Have you ever been diagnosed with depression before?
No, I don’t think I’ve ever been formally diagnosed with it before.
Have you had any other episodes of feeling overwhelmed by sadness or despair before this one?
No, not really. I mean, I’ve had low points before, like anyone, but I don’t remember another time where it felt this heavy or overwhelming.
Have you had more than one episode of depression in your lifetime?
No, I don’t think so. I’ve had rough stretches before, but nothing I’d call another episode like this.
Have you had any episodes of depression before this one that lasted for at least two weeks?
Not that I can remember. I’ve had bad days or maybe a rough week here and there, but I don’t think I’ve had anything before this that lasted two weeks or more.
Have you experienced any periods of depression similar to this one before in your life?
No, I don’t think I have. I’ve had hard times before, but nothing that felt similar to this or lasted like this.
Have you had any other episodes of depression in your life before this one?
No, not before this. I’ve had difficult periods, but I wouldn’t call them episodes like this one.
